column1: # G2 demonstration fabric: 4x4 grid with a 2x2 LOGIC4 core inside a CAP_* ring
# (issue #80). LOGIC4 is the only logic tile; CAP_* are non-logic boundary
# terminators that FABulous 2.2.0's nextpnr-model step requires. Corners are
# unused. Logic tiles sit at X1Y1
# The only change from the stamped 3x3 harness in rtl/common/fabulous/fabric.csv
# is the FabricBegin..FabricEnd grid: the ParametersBegin..ParametersEnd block
# path still resolves because this description is overlaid into a copy of the
# CAP_N/CAP_S declare only NORTH/SOUTH wires and CAP_E/CAP_W only EAST/WEST
# they are position-agnostic single-axis terminators: two of the same cap tile
# side by side along the edge it terminates is well-formed.
